title: Chapter 378 Base Military Meeting
content:
Chapter 378 Base Military Meeting

The base where Wang Shuo was located was upgraded to the main base at this time.

Inside the base, a teleportation array appeared.

Every friendly army unit can be teleported here.

The conditions for both sides to win, in addition to annihilating the opponent, can also destroy the opponent's main base.

Wang Shuo immediately issued the first order to all the main generals.

"Please all generals, teleport to the main base and hold a military meeting."

Although Wang Shuo is now the supreme commander.

But there is no mandatory constraint on the other 99 generals of the commander.

In other words, they can disobey Wang Shuo.

These people are elites from various empires on the continent. Many of them have high self-esteem and are not willing to be inferior to others.

But at this time, everyone is tied to a rope. If they are not united, they will easily be defeated one by one by the enemy camp.

So after Wang Shuo issued the order, the main generals still rushed over quickly.

However, most of them wanted to see how Wang Shuo planned to deploy the next battle.

As for whether you should listen to him or not, it depends on the situation.

If the other party is a genius commander, it is okay to obey his command. If the commander is a reckless man, then sorry, we will not serve him.

Half an hour later, there were still nearly 10 people who completely ignored Wang Shuo's orders and were too lazy to even attend the first military meeting.

Wang Shuo saw that among these nearly 10 people, 6 had formed a team, gathered together, and were quickly heading to the border.

The remaining three people were fighting on their own, and were still sweeping outside with their own men.

Wang Shuo did not have the extra energy to take care of them now.

In the main base, 90 main generals were already standing scattered near the teleportation array.

"Everyone, we are like-minded allies at this time, with the same goal, that is, to win this battle."

"I wonder if you have any suggestions for this battle?"

Wang Shuo did not express his thoughts at the beginning. After all, there were too many people, and everyone had their own ideas. If you don't let others express their ideas, it will be difficult to win the recognition of others.

"Commander, I think we should attack quickly now. As the saying goes, speed is of the essence in war. The other side must also be consolidating its forces. The longer the meeting lasts, the more advantages the other side will have."

"I don't think so. Sharpening the knife does not delay the chopping of wood. We now lack a basic understanding of the entire battlefield. If we attack rashly, if we are ambushed by the opponent, it will be doomed."

"I think we should attack the Earth Mother Worm first to obtain more resources. After all, we still have many main generals and the arms are not complete. It feels a bit disadvantageous to fight like this."

"Commander, I have an idea. I think we should gather all the generals together to form a top combat team..."

There are basically no brainless generals here. Everyone has put forward their own ideas.

However, some generals do not trust others. Instead of handing their lives to others, it is better to work alone.

Wang Shuo listened to everyone's opinions.

At present, it is undoubtedly a good idea to organize all the generals into a unit.

But Wang Shuo knows without thinking that most people probably will not agree with this.

But he still asked symbolically: "What do you think about organizing the generals into a small team?"

At this time, everyone below was silent.

Although he had expected it in his heart, Wang Shuo was also quite helpless.

The person who made such a request was undoubtedly an idealist.
